cards.ex: The fighting flared up again last night after a brief ceasefire.
cards.exUz: Qisqa sulhdan so'ng, kecha kechqurun janglar yana avj oldi.
cards.uzDef: Nizolar, kasalliklar yoki zo'ravonlik birdan kuchayib ketishi.

cards.ex: War could break out if diplomatic talks fail.
cards.exUz: Agar diplomatik muzokaralar muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, urush boshlanishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Urush, jang yoki to'satdan zo'ravonlik boshlanishi.

cards.ex: Activists are calling for an end to the arms trade.
cards.exUz: Faollar qurol savdosini to'xtatishga chaqirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Nimagaдир ochiq talab qilmoq yoki qaysidir harakatni bajarishni so'ramoq.

cards.ex: Civilians were caught in the crossfire during the battle.
cards.exUz: Jang paytida tinch aholi jangovar harakatlar o'rtasida qolib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Jangovar harakatlar o'rtasida qolib ketmoq.

cards.ex: There's hope that peace talks will lead to a lasting solution.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik muzokaralari uzoq muddatli yechimga olib kelishiga umid bor.
cards.uzDef: Urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida tinchlik o'rnatish uchun muzokaralar.

cards.ex: The rebels are losing ground to the government forces.
cards.exUz: Isyonchilar hukumat kuchlariga o'z pozitsiyalarini yo'qotmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Dushman hujumi ostida hududni yoki ustunlikni yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: Reporters risked their lives to report from the front lines.
cards.exUz: Reportyorlar front chizig'idan xabar berish uchun o'z hayotlarini xavf ostiga qo'ydilar.
cards.uzDef: Urushning eng xavfli, oldingi chizig'ida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The war-torn country is struggling to rebuild its infrastructure.
cards.exUz: Urush vayron qilgan mamlakat infratuzilmasini qayta qurishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Urush natijasida jiddiy zarar ko'rgan hudud.

cards.ex: The military tried to minimize collateral damage during the bombing.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar bombardimon paytida tasodifiy zararni kamaytirishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy harakatlar natijasida tinch aholiga yetkazilgan zarar.

cards.ex: It's important to take a stand against injustice.
cards.exUz: Adolatsizlikka qarshi turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy pozitsiyani egallab, nimagadir qarshi chiqmoq.

cards.ex: After years of feuding, they decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik adovatdan so'ng, ular urushni tugatishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi janjallarni unutib, yarashmoq.

cards.ex: They hired a mediator to help settle the dispute.
cards.exUz: Ular nizoni hal qilishda yordam berish uchun vositachini yolladilar.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikni muzokaralar yoki murosaga kelish orqali hal qilmoq.

cards.ex: Many people are seeking refuge in neighboring countries.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar qo'shni davlatlardan boshpana izlamoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Xavfdan qochib, xavfsiz joy izlamoq.

cards.ex: The government's actions could escalate tensions in the region.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning harakatlari mintaqadagi keskinlikni kuchaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada xavfli holatga olib kelmoq.

cards.ex: The region has been plagued by armed conflict for decades.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa o'nlab yillar davomida qurolli to'qnashuvdan aziyat chekmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qurolli kuchlar ishtirokidagi jiddiy urush yoki jang.

cards.ex: Both sides agreed to call a truce to allow for negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ikki tomon muzokaralar olib borish uchun sulh e'lon qilishga rozi bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik jangni to'xtatish haqida kelishmoq.

cards.ex: Neither side is willing to make concessions.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon imtiyoz berishni xohlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nizoni hal qilish uchun talablardan voz kechmoq.

cards.ex: His comments only fueled the fire and made things worse.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari faqat o'tga moy sepi va vaziyatni yomonlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: We need to draw a line and say enough is enough.
cards.exUz: Biz chiziq tortishimiz va bas, yetar deyishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan xatti-harakatlar uchun chegara belgilamoq.

cards.ex: They decided to fight back against the oppressive regime.
cards.exUz: Ular zulmkor rejimga qarshi kurashishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Hujumga javoban qarshilik ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: The government is trying to downplay the conflict to avoid panic.
cards.exUz: Hukumat vahima oldini olish uchun nizoni kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning jiddiyligini ahamiyatsiz qilib ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Both parties are seeking resolution to the dispute.
cards.exUz: Ikki tomon ham nizoga yechim izlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yo'llarini izlash.

cards.ex: The UN sent in a peacekeeping force to monitor the ceasefire.
cards.exUz: BMT sulhni nazorat qilish uchun tinchlikparvar kuchlarni yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Nizolarni bartaraf etish uchun yuborilgan xalqaro kuchlar.

cards.ex: The conflict has turned into a war of attrition.
cards.exUz: Mojaro holdan toydiruvchi urushga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan va har ikki tomonni ham holdan toydiradigan urush.

cards.ex: The region is experiencing a fragile peace after years of conflict.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa ko'p yillik mojarolardan so'ng mo'rt tinchlikni boshdan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan notinch tinchlik.

cards.ex: Diplomatic efforts are underway to prevent further escalation.
cards.exUz: Vaziyatning yanada keskinlashuviga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun diplomatik harakatlar olib borilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nizoni tinch yo'l bilan hal qilishga qaratilgan harakatlar.

cards.ex: The border dispute remains a bone of contention between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Chegara mojarosi ikki davlat o'rtasida asosiy bahs mavzusi bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikning asosiy sababi.

cards.ex: The country is on a war footing after the attack.
cards.exUz: Hujumdan so'ng mamlakat urush holatida.
cards.uzDef: Urushga tayyorgarlik ko'rish holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets out of control.
cards.exUz: Biz bu muammoni nazoratdan chiqib ketishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishidan oldin uni to'xtatib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: They won the battle, but they haven't won the war yet.
cards.exUz: Ular jangda g'alaba qozonishdi, ammo ular hali urushda g'alaba qozonishgani yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir jang yoki bahsda g'alaba qozonmoq.
